tool_input.command:
t=$(mktemp -d) && mkdir -p "$t/d"
for s in 20260101-000000 20260102-000000 20260103-000000 20260104-000000; do : > "$t/d/app-$s.tar.gz"; done
echo "--- rotate --dry-run --keep=2 (equals form, all flags) ---"
bash rotate.sh --dry-run --keep=2 --name app --dest "$t/d" --quiet
echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- rotate --help ---"; bash rotate.sh --help >/dev/null; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- rotate unknown flag ---"; bash rotate.sh --dest "$t/d" --name app --bogus 2>/dev/null; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- rotate keep 2, real run (oldest 2 go) ---"
bash rotate.sh --name app --dest "$t/d" -q | sort; ls "$t/d" | sort
echo "--- verify --name filter, name with spaces ---"
mkdir -p "$t/v" && printf 'a\n' > "$t/v/my backup-20260101-000000.tar.gz" && printf 'b\n' > "$t/v/plain.tar.gz"
(cd "$t/v" && shasum -a 256 *.tar.gz > all.sha256 && while read -r h n; do echo "$h  $n" > "$n.sha256"; done < all.sha256)
bash verify.sh --dest "$t/v" --name "my backup" --quiet; echo "rc=$?"
bash verify.sh --dest "$t/v" --quiet; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- verify --help ---"; bash verify.sh --help >/dev/null; echo "rc=$?"
rm -rf "$t"
tool_input.description: Smoke-test refactored rotate/verify flags and behavior

tool_input.command: t=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$t/d"; for s in 20260101-000000 20260102-000000 20260103-000000 20260104-000000; do : > "$t/d/app-$s.tar.gz"; done; bash -x rotate.sh --name app --dest "$t/d" --keep 2 --quiet 2>&1 | tail -30; echo "rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; ls "$t/d"; rm -rf "$t"
tool_input.description: Trace rotate.sh real-run to see why nothing was deleted

result:
The sandbox won't delete outside the repo dir, so the two throwaway smoke scripts remain in `/Users/vitor/.cache/flashnext-concurrency/claude-work/` (outside the repo, untracked) — say the word and I'll remove them with approval.

The repo itself is clean. What changed:

- **Bug 1, `rotate.sh`** — `surplus()` used `tail -n +"$keep"`, which selects from the keep-th *oldest* entry *through* the newest, so the newest archive was always a delete candidate and it acted even at `total == keep` (early exit used `-lt`). Now it exits at `total -le keep` and surplus is the oldest `total - keep` entries (`head -n "$((total - keep))"`).
- **Bug 2, `verify.sh`** — the sidecar filename came from `awk '{print $2}'`, truncating at the first space so `my backup-…tar.gz` looked "missing". The digest is the first word and the filename is now taken as the rest of the line (`read -r expected file`).
- **Refactor** — new `lib/common.sh` holds the shared option parser (`--dest/--name/--keep/--quiet/--dry-run/--help/parse_local_option` hook, identical to before, with double-source guard like `lib/log.sh`) and `resolve_dir`; `rotate.sh` and `verify.sh` source it. `backup.sh`, `restore.sh`, `report.sh` untouched.
- **Tests** — a rotate group (exactly N → nothing deleted, rc 0; over N → only the oldest deleted with its sidecar, newest kept) and a verify group for a name containing a space. All 11 checks pass: `bash tests/run_tests.sh` → `all tests passed`.

Changed: `rotate.sh`, `verify.sh`, `tests/run_tests.sh`, plus new `lib/common.sh`.
